category: other: mug tipped in the grip during placement - pitched forward while being lowered to the tray, then held tipped at the tray for ~650 steps and released on its side
what_happened: Scene: layout 5 (same black CoffeeMachine042 as s4: two cup-icon buttons on the upper front, two nozzles), grey mug_9 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: first close on air 95, grasp 111 by the rim, carried down to the front of the tray by ~212. While it was lowered and pushed towards the tray (240-283) the mug rotated in the fingers: the wrist view shows it pitching forward until its side and handle face up, tipped > 45 deg from 283. The policy kept holding the tipped mug at the tray and nozzles from 283 to 939 (~650 steps, 33 s), shifting it around (at target only briefly while held: 609-687, 691-694, 908-932; the arm touched the machine 657-691 and 888-944). It released at 939, 0.0459 m from the pour site; the mug lay on its side on the tray (tilt 82.6 deg), 0.0422 m from the pour site at the end. Stage 1: 960-1000 the gripper moved up along the machine front past the buttons (touch 969-987, no press) and then withdrew; the machine never turned on.
causal_chain: rim grasp; mug pitches forward in the grip while being lowered to the tray (240-283) -> policy holds the tipped mug at the tray 283-939 without resolving it -> released lying on its side 0.046 m from the pour site (939) -> ~260 steps left, one pass along the buttons without a press -> timeout
self_recovery: it kept re-positioning the tipped mug for 650 steps (it was within 4 cm briefly while still held) but never set it upright or let go in position.
official_criterion_notes: The mug ended lying on its side 0.042 m from the pour site - 2 mm outside the tolerance. Had it been 2 mm closer, stage 0 would have counted a toppled mug as placed (no upright test), as in s5.
uncertain_about: What exactly rotated the mug (contact with the tray front edge vs. gravity about a loose rim grasp); the wrist view shows the rotation but not the contact.
